name: Kotlin Number Guess
description:
Modern number guessing in Kotlin.

   kotlinc -script game.kt
   Thinking of a number...
   Guess: 50
   Too High!
   Guess: 25
   Too Low!
   Guess: 37
   You Win! 🎉

Learn: Kotlin, readLine(), when expressions.

fields.label: Your name
fields.help: Shown in the welcome and victory messages.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.help: Easy: 1-50 with 10 guesses. Normal: 1-100 with 7 guesses. Hard: 1-200 with 5 guesses.
